kits.title: Daily driver kit
kits.blurb: The first five things most Junkies install on a fresh watch.

picks.name: Muninn — Battery Wisdom
picks.why: Best battery prediction / monitoring consensus pick on r/pebble.

picks.name: Find My Phone
picks.why: No companion drama — ping the phone from your wrist.

picks.name: Music Boss
picks.why: The media remote. Layout presets shine on Time 2 & Round 2.

picks.name: Official Timer + Stopwatch
picks.why: Weirdly not always preinstalled — grab them first.

picks.name: Facebrowser
picks.why: Browse face thumbnails on-watch before you commit.

kits.title: Watchface starter pack
kits.blurb: Legible, loved, and repeatedly named in 2025–26 community threads.

picks.name: TimeStyle / BrutalTimeStyle
picks.why: The face people keep coming back to.

picks.name: Analog Pulse
picks.why: Dressy analog that still works on PT2.

notes: Use the Rebble/Core store Most Loved and Featured collections — they reflect real installs, not ads.
Animated faces look incredible and eat battery. Check battery-impact hints in the new store when available.
Filter by hardware (aplite / basalt / chalk / diorite / emery / gabbro) so you don't sideload a face that won't fit.
